description: Render all 22 SOC 2 policies (or the subset named in `slugs`) as Markdown from the company intake. Output is large (roughly 250 KB for all 22): the first content item is an index, then one item per policy starting with an HTML comment naming its file, e.g. <!-- file: 03-access-control-policy.md -->. Prefer render_policy when the user only needs one or two documents.

intake.description: The company intake. Only company, product, security_owner, approver and incident_contact are required; any omitted field takes its default (see intake_questions; effective_date defaults to today).

app_type.description: Type of product. One of: Web SaaS, API, Mobile, Multiple

approver.description: Person who approves policies, as "Name, Title". (required)

backup_cadence.description: How often backups run (free text, optional, e.g. Daily).

backup_tool.description: Backup tool or service (free text, optional).

cloud.description: One or more cloud/hosting providers. Any of: AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Fly.io, Hetzner, Cloudflare, Other

company.description: Legal or trading name used on every policy document. (required)

data_types.description: Sensitive data types handled. Any of: PII, PHI, Payment (or empty list).

effective_date.description: Effective date of this policy version, as YYYY-MM-DD.

idp.description: Identity provider / SSO. One of: Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra, JumpCloud, None

incident_contact.description: Email or channel for reporting incidents. (required)

mdm.description: Mobile device management tool, or empty if none (free text, optional).

mfa.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enforced. true or false.

password_manager.description: Password manager in use, or empty if none (free text, optional).

product.description: Name of the product or service the policies describe. (required)

review_cadence.description: How often policies are reviewed. One of: Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly (used by "policyseed check").

scm.description: Source control host. One of: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Other

security_owner.description: Person accountable for security, as "Name, Title". (required)

tsc_scope.description: Trust Services Criteria in scope. One or more of: Security, Availability, Confidentiality

vendors.description: Named vendors to call out in policy text (free text list, optional, up to 10).

work_model.description: How the team works. One of: Remote, Hybrid, Office

slugs.description: Optional subset of policy slugs to render. Omit to render all 22.

name: render_all
title: Render all policies
